name: ai-skill-gap-analyzer
description: AI-Powered Skill Gap Analyzer and Intelligent Career Acceleration Agent (SkillGap AI)

scripts.test:unit: node -e "const { runDeterministicAnalysis } = require('./server/services/deterministicAnalyzer'); const res = runDeterministicAnalysis({ cgpa: 8.2, targetSpecialization: 'Artificial Intelligence', budgetInr: 1500000, preferredCountry: 'Germany', skills: ['Python', 'SQL', 'Machine Learning'] }); console.log('Unit Test Passed! Top match:', res.recommendations[0].university.name, 'Score:', res.recommendations[0].match_score);"
